# fusescope_rum_application (Data Source)

Reads a Real User Monitoring application. Its keys are not readable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fusescope_rum_application" "example" {
  id = "0192a9c2-1234-7abc-8def-0123456789ab"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `allowed_origins` (List of String) Browser origins allowed to ingest.
- `allowed_package_names` (List of String) Android package names allowed to ingest.
- `environment` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String)
- `org_id` (String)
- `pii_policy` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pii_policy))
- `platform` (String)
- `sample_rate` (Number)
- `source_maps` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source_maps))
- `trace_propagation_urls` (List of String) URL prefixes of APIs the SDK sends `traceparent` to.
